Experience the most discussed match in FIFA World Cup football history in 10 breathless minutes. From the controversy of the "Hand of God" to the sheer genius of the "Goal of the Century", witness Diego Maradona’s defining performance against England at the Azteca. Pure football theatre. #fifaworldcup1986 #maradona #argentina #england #fifaworldcup #worldcup
